best_idea: Load a creature's atlas and animation set on first sight in a zone, ref-count it per species and tint, and free it when the last instance leaves, with a missing-texture fallback so a bad asset never blanks the scene.
decision_why: Keep first-holder-loads and last-holder-frees per species+tint; add the texture free and the post-await count check the donor lacks, since the donor frees animation definitions only and never the atlas texture. Fits zones-as-data because creature clips are loaded per zone.
acceptance: Client test: spawn three creatures of one species, despawn all three, assert the animation keys and the atlas are gone; a fourth spawn reloads the atlas exactly once.
